image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a laminated restaurant menu. The menu features colorful illustrations of food dishes (including what appears to be curry, rice, and desserts) alongside text descriptions and prices. The text is in a non-Latin script (likely Thai), with some English words visible. There are significant glare and reflections on the glossy surface, obscuring some details. To the left, another section of the menu or a different menu is partially visible.

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the text areas, particularly the bottom center and right side.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The non-Latin script characters appear malformed and inconsistent. Some strokes merge into each other, and the character structures do not look like valid Thai (or similar) script. They resemble 'AI-hallucinated' text where the shape of writing is mimicked but the linguistic structure is absent. The English text 'DESSERT' is also slightly warped.

artifact_observations.location: Food illustrations, specifically the green curry bowl and the rice dish.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The textures of the food look overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the granular detail expected in high-resolution food photography. The edges of the food items bleed slightly into the white background.

artifact_observations.location: Left edge of the main menu panel.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The vertical alignment of the text and images seems to waver slightly, not following a perfect straight line despite the flat surface, suggesting minor geometric warping.

focus_areas: Legibility and structural validity of the non-Latin text.
Realism and edge definition of the food illustrations.
Consistency of the grid layout (alignment of text vs images).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In AI-generated menus, fake text is common. If the image_text_auditor confirms the script is nonsensical or malformed, this is a significant defect. Also, evaluate if the 'plastic' look of the food is an artistic choice or a generation failure.
